title: Estimate-Stage Fee Schedule of Repair Estimates & Appointments
content:
Schedule of the flat estimate-stage fees of Repair Estimates & Appointments, by estimate type. A type whose fee is shown as 0.00 USD posts no charge of that kind.

| Estimate type | Teardown fee | Pre-repair diagnostic scan fee | Structural measurement fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Drive-In Estimate | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Scheduled Estimate | 0.00 USD | 49.95 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Mobile Estimate | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 185.00 USD | 49.95 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 365.00 USD | 49.95 USD | 145.00 USD |

Fee descriptions:

- **Teardown fee** — the teardown fee posted when the teardown is performed.
- **Pre-repair diagnostic scan fee** — the diagnostic scan fee posted when the pre-repair scan is performed.
- **Structural measurement fee** — the structural measurement fee posted when the measurement report is produced.

The scan fee is the same, 49.95 USD, on every type that scans; the teardown fee is 185.00 USD on the Blueprint Teardown Estimate and 365.00 USD on the Structural Blueprint Estimate; only the Structural Blueprint Estimate carries a measurement fee, 145.00 USD.
